name: Juan Camilo Villegas
headline: Advisor | Founder | Board Member |
about:
I am a passionate entrepreneur and strategic growth expert with a strong background in empowering businesses to achieve sustainable success. As founder and Developer of Cawi, I have channeled my expertise into creating a solution that helps individuals and families to nourish their health and wallet by proving a community capable of creating recipes, and nutrition plans from one dollar a day and telling our users where to purchase to find the best possible price. Cawi is designed to empower consumers with the knowledge and tools to make informed purchasing decisions, ultimately enhancing their financial well-being.

My journey into entrepreneurship began with JC Advisors, a consulting firm I co-founded to help entrepreneurs maximize their business growth through our unique Collective Growth System. This system has been key for many companies I led in the past, and it is the core of cawi.

With an MBA from Hult International Business School, I have honed my ability to develop and execute business strategies that unlock collective growth. My role at JC Advisors has allowed me to collaborate with a wide range of businesses, providing innovative solutions and optimizing operational efficiency to foster sustainable growth.

In addition to my entrepreneurial ventures, I serve as a Board Member at Tania, where I contribute to strategic decision-making and offer insights that drive the company’s success. My experience across various industries has equipped me with a versatile skill set, enabling me to thrive in dynamic environments and lead transformative change.

As a thought leader and speaker, I am dedicated to sharing my knowledge and inspiring others to embrace collective growth strategies. Through industry conferences, workshops, and publications, I aim to empower businesses and entrepreneurs to realize their full potential.
